MathJax 4.1.3 and @mathjax/mathjax-newcm-font 4.1.3

Source: https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax and https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax-fonts
Distributed under the Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).

The tex-svg.js bundle is the font package's tex-mml-svg-mathjax-newcm.js.
fonts/svg/dynamic contains that font's additional SVG glyph data. input/tex
contains MathJax's TeX extensions. No application runtime CDN is used.
